items.name:
One aspect of our photo brief was to take portraits of festival-goers in the context of the festival. I set myself up by the beer tent and grabbed people as they went past. Turned out ok!

Strobist info: a single 580EXII at full power (it was a sunny day) into a Lastolite Ezybox soft box, camera left. 

I used a super clamp to attach my light to a scaffolding pole which was there to hold up festival lighting. Neatly solved the both wind and safety issues of a light on a stand.
